description.value: The Atrium Hotel Vancouver is an independent hotel on East Hastings Street, positioned close to Hastings Park and the PNE grounds. It offers a range of room configurations from standard queens to kitchenette suites, catering to solo travellers, families, and groups. The hotel promotes itself as a practical base for accessing downtown Vancouver, Stanley Park, BC Place, and the Convention Centre.
